data: What are the specific reward values for the DIP-DQN algorithm in the SF Restaurants environment at 6000 training dialogues?

The question asks for the specific reward values of the DIP-DQN algorithm in the SF Restaurants environment at 6000 training dialogues. From the caption, we know that the learning curves for Feudal-DQN and DIP-DQN are compared to the two best performing algorithms in (Casanueva et al., 2017), which are DQN and GP-Sarsa. The shaded area represents the mean ± the standard deviation over ten random seeds.

In the figure, the DIP-DQN line is represented by an orange line. To find the reward value at 6000 training dialogues, we need to look at the position of the orange line on the y-axis when the x-axis reaches 6000.

From the figure, we can see that the DIP-DQN line is above the DQN and GP-Sarsa lines, indicating that it performs better than both. At approximately 6000 training dialogues, the DIP-DQN line is around 10 on the y-axis. Therefore, the specific reward value for the DIP-DQN algorithm in the SF Restaurants environment at 6000 training dialogues is approximately 10.
